records.source: I've been having a hard time staying focused lately.$l
records.translation: Nahihirapan akong manatiling nakatuon nitong huli.$l

records.source: Of course you do. If you didn't I'd think you were crazy. Or some kind of nerd.
records.translation: Siyempre. Kung hindi, iisipin kong baliw ka. O isang uri ng nerd.

records.source: Really? You must be some kind of weirdo.$a#$b#Sorry.
records.translation: Talaga? Siguro ay isa kang kakatwang tao.$a#$b#Paumanhin.

records.source: No, I'm not! You're just trying to flatter me.$a
records.translation: Hindi, hindi ako ganoon! Binobola mo lang ako.$a

records.source: Yeah, I guess you're right...$s
records.translation: Oo, siguro ay tama ka...$s

records.source: You were supposed to disagree with me.$a
records.translation: Dapat ay kinontra mo ako.$a

records.source: Yes... I know. That's why I've been so determined to be successful with my sports stuff...$9#$b#Make it or not... As long as I try my hardest I think she'd be proud. Thanks.
records.translation: Oo... Alam ko. Kaya determinado akong magtagumpay sa isports...$9#$b#Magtagumpay man o hindi... Basta ibigay ko ang buong makakaya ko, sa tingin ko'y ipagmamalaki niya ako. Salamat.

records.source: Wow... It's the anniversary of my Mom's death! Have a heart...$a
records.translation: Wow... Anibersaryo ng pagkamatay ni Nanay! Maawa ka naman...$a

records.source: ...Thanks, @.#$b#You... you're different than the other guys. More sensitive.$l^You've become my best friend in the whole town... #$b#I'm glad.^Is that embarrassing to say?$l
records.translation: ...Salamat, @.#$b#Ikaw... naiiba ka sa ibang lalaki. Mas sensitibo.$l^Ikaw na ang pinakamatalik kong kaibigan sa buong bayan... #$b#Natutuwa ako.^Nakakahiya bang sabihin iyon?$l

records.source: That doesn't make me feel any better, jerk.$a
records.translation: Hindi gumagaan ang pakiramdam ko riyan, tarantado.$a

records.source: That's an interesting thought...
records.translation: Kawili-wiling kaisipan iyan...

records.source: They would never do that!$a
records.translation: Hindi nila kailanman gagawin iyon!$a

records.source: ...Maybe you're right... I dunno.$s
records.translation: ...Baka tama ka... Ewan ko.$s

records.source: Hey. Summer is definitely the best time of year.#$e#Right now is great because we've got the whole season to look forward to. Catch you later.
records.translation: Hoy. Talagang tag-init ang pinakamagandang panahon ng taon.#$e#Napakaganda ngayon dahil maaari pa nating abangan ang buong panahon. Magkita tayo mamaya.

records.source: Hey, farmer guy. You look a little burnt.^Hey Farmer girl. You've got a nice tan going.$h#$e#The more I practice this summer, the easier it'll be for me to go pro.#$e#Then you'd be able to say you knew me once. Cool, huh?
records.translation: Hoy, binatang magsasaka. Mukha kang medyo nasunog sa araw.^Hoy, dalagang magsasaka. Maganda ang pagkakaitim ng balat mo.$h#$e#Habang mas marami akong pagsasanay ngayong tag-init, mas madali para sa akin ang maging propesyonal.#$e#Pagkatapos ay masasabi mong nakilala mo ako noon. Astig, hindi ba?

records.source: If my hair wasn't so popular with the ladies, I swear I'd shave it all off in a second.#$e#*sigh*... Life can be tough.
records.translation: Kung hindi lang sikat sa mga babae ang buhok ko, siguradong aahitin ko agad ang lahat.#$e#*buntong-hininga*... Maaaring mahirap ang buhay.

records.source: Hey farm guy, I've got a question for you.^Hey Farm girl, I've got a question for you.#$b#$q 52/53 summer_Wed_01_old#Do you think I'll ever turn pro?#$r 52 30 summer_Wed_01_01#You're destined to be a sports legend#$r 52 0 summer_Wed_01_02#Maybe, if you practice a lot#$r 53 -50 summer_Wed_01_03#No, you'll most likely fail and become a salesman
records.translation: Hoy, binatang magsasaka, may tanong ako sa iyo.^Hoy, dalagang magsasaka, may tanong ako sa iyo.#$b#$q 52/53 summer_Wed_01_old#Sa tingin mo ba ay magiging propesyonal ako balang araw?#$r 52 30 summer_Wed_01_01#Nakatadhana kang maging alamat sa isports#$r 52 0 summer_Wed_01_02#Siguro, kung magsasanay ka nang husto#$r 53 -50 summer_Wed_01_03#Hindi, malamang ay mabibigo ka at magiging tindero

records.source: $p 52#Hey, when I turn pro you can say you were my first "fan". Not bad, huh?|Hey, I've been practicing twice as hard so I can turn pro and prove you wrong. You just wait.$a
records.translation: $p 52#Hoy, kapag propesyonal na ako, masasabi mong ikaw ang una kong “tagahanga”. Hindi masama, ha?|Hoy, doble na ang pagsasanay ko upang maging propesyonal at patunayang mali ka. Hintayin mo lang.$a

records.source: Hey, now that's what I'm talking about!$h#$e#You're cooler than I thought.
records.translation: Hoy, iyan ang gusto kong marinig!$h#$e#Mas astig ka kaysa sa akala ko.

records.source: Yeah, well I'm so good I'm not going to have to practice all that much.$u
records.translation: Oo, aba, napakahusay ko kaya hindi ko na kailangang magsanay nang ganoon kadalas.$u

records.source: That's insane. You're just jealous that I'm talented and popular and you're not.$a^That's ridiculous. You're just jealous that I'm way more popular than you'll ever be, freak.$a#$e#Get away from me.$a
records.translation: Kabaliwan iyan. Naiinggit ka lang dahil talentado at sikat ako at hindi ikaw.$a^Katawa-tawa iyan. Naiinggit ka lang dahil di-hamak na mas sikat ako kaysa sa magiging kasikatan mo kailanman, kakatwang nilalang.$a#$e#Lumayo ka sa akin.$a

records.source: Hey, you must be getting pretty strong working on that farm all day.^Hey, you must be getting pretty fit working on that farm all day.#$e#Maybe you'll reach my level some day. Something to look forward to, huh?#$e#Why do you have that look on your face?
records.translation: Hoy, siguradong lumalakas ka sa maghapong pagtatrabaho sa bukid.^Hoy, siguradong bumubuti ang pangangatawan mo sa maghapong pagtatrabaho sa bukid.#$e#Baka maabot mo ang antas ko balang araw. May aasamin ka, ano?#$e#Bakit ganyan ang mukha mo?

records.source: What do you want?#$e#I've got more important things to do right now.
records.translation: Ano ang gusto mo?#$e#May mas mahahalaga akong gagawin ngayon.

records.source: Mmmm... I smell a barbeque.#$e#Damn I could go for a burger.
records.translation: Mmmm... Naaamoy ko ang inihaw.#$e#Naku, gusto ko ng burger.

records.source: I got these new shoes yesterday 'cuz my old pair had a brown smudge.#$b#I just threw them into the garbage. I would've donated them but I don't like the idea of some weirdo wearing my shoes, ya know?#$e#...What?$a
records.translation: Bumili ako kahapon ng bagong sapatos dahil may kayumangging mantsa ang luma ko.#$b#Itinapon ko lang ang mga iyon sa basura. Ipamimigay ko sana pero ayaw kong isipin na may kakatwang taong magsusuot ng sapatos ko, alam mo?#$e#...Ano?$a

records.source: Oh wow...your shoes are a little dirty... but that's fine, too!#$e#Different people have different tastes I guess.
records.translation: Ah, wow... medyo marumi ang sapatos mo... pero ayos lang din iyan!#$e#Siguro ay magkakaiba lang ang hilig ng mga tao.

records.source: Hey, you look like you're getting into some good shape this summer!#$b#All that farm work is paying off, huh?
records.translation: Hoy, mukhang gumaganda ang pangangatawan mo ngayong tag-init!#$b#Sulit ang lahat ng gawain sa bukid, ano?

records.source: Hey, nice tan.
records.translation: Hoy, maganda ang pagkakaitim ng balat mo.

records.source: Sorry my room is so messy.$s#$e#It's just hard to always remember to clean. I'm trying to get better, though.
records.translation: Paumanhin kung napakagulo ng kuwarto ko.$s#$e#Mahirap lang talagang laging tandaang maglinis. Pero sinisikap kong mas maging masinop.

records.source: You know, I actually wouldn't mind being a farmer... it seems a lot like playing sports, in a way.#$e#I like being outdoors and doing things with my hands.
records.translation: Alam mo, ayos lang talaga sa akin ang maging magsasaka... sa isang paraan, parang paglalaro iyon ng isports.#$e#Gusto kong nasa labas at gumagawa ng mga bagay gamit ang mga kamay ko.

records.source: I've been trying to do more reading lately... I feel like I've been neglecting my brain for years because of my athletic obsession.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong magbasa nang mas madalas nitong huli... Pakiramdam ko'y ilang taon ko nang napapabayaan ang utak ko dahil sa pagkahumaling ko sa palakasan.

records.source: Sure, it's getting colder... But it's still warm enough for sports!#$e#That's all I care about.
records.translation: Oo, lumalamig na... Pero sapat pa rin ang init para sa isports!#$e#Iyon lang ang mahalaga sa akin.

records.source: My grandma told me I should spend more time studying.#$e#I was like, '...Grams, don't fret. I'm turning pro!'$h#$e#Studying is for nerds, anyway.
records.translation: Sinabi ni Lola na dapat akong maglaan ng mas maraming oras sa pag-aaral.#$e#Sabi ko, “...Lola, huwag kang mag-alala. Magiging propesyonal ako!”$h#$e#Para lang sa mga nerd ang pag-aaral.

records.source: Hey, I want to ask you something.^Hey, can I ask you something?#$e#$q 54/55 fall_Wed_01_old#Do you think the ladies like my haircut?^What do you think about my haircut?#$r 54 30 fall_Wed_01_01#It looks very fashionable.#$r 55 -30 fall_Wed_01_02#It looks like some kind of fungal growth.
records.translation: Hoy, may gusto akong itanong sa iyo.^Hoy, may maaari ba akong itanong sa iyo?#$e#$q 54/55 fall_Wed_01_old#Sa tingin mo ba ay gusto ng mga babae ang gupit ko?^Ano ang palagay mo sa gupit ko?#$r 54 30 fall_Wed_01_01#Mukhang napakauso.#$r 55 -30 fall_Wed_01_02#Mukha itong isang uri ng tumutubong amag.

records.source: I put too much gel in my hair today. It kind of hurts.#$e#Don't touch it!#$e#...what?
records.translation: Sobra ang inilagay kong gel sa buhok ko ngayon. Medyo masakit.#$e#Huwag mong hawakan!#$e#...ano?

records.source: Yeah, I know. That's why I have it like this.
records.translation: Oo, alam ko. Kaya ganito ang ayos ko.

records.source: Yeah right. You're just jealous that I look so good.
records.translation: Talaga lang. Naiinggit ka lang dahil napakaganda ng hitsura ko.

records.source: What's up?#$e#Isn't your name, like, %firstnameletter%name, or something?#$e#Oh. It's @? Okay. Sorry.
records.translation: Ano'ng balita?#$e#Hindi ba parang %firstnameletter%name ang pangalan mo o ano?#$e#Ah. @ pala? Sige. Paumanhin.

records.source: I'm going to do two hundred sit-ups tonight.#$b#I'm pretty dedicated, aren't I?$h#$e#Need anything else?
records.translation: Magse-sit-up ako nang dalawang daang beses ngayong gabi.#$b#Talagang determinado ako, hindi ba?$h#$e#May kailangan ka pa?

records.source: I think you can find salmon in the river this time of year.#$e#At least that's what I heard.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y may mahahanap kang salmon sa ilog sa ganitong panahon ng taon.#$e#Iyon ang narinig ko, kahit paano.

records.source: Hey, the gridball game is on today!#$e#Sundays are pretty awesome in the fall.$u
records.translation: Hoy, ipinapalabas ngayon ang laro ng gridball!#$e#Talagang napakasaya ng mga Linggo tuwing taglagas.$u

records.source: What's up, @?
records.translation: Ano'ng balita, @?

records.source: I'm going to do a ton of sit-ups tonight.#$e#You have to work really hard if you want to achieve your maximum potential.
records.translation: Magse-sit-up ako nang napakaraming beses ngayong gabi.#$e#Kailangan mong magsikap nang husto kung gusto mong maabot ang pinakamataas mong kakayahan.

records.source: My grandma told me I should spend more time studying.#$e#Maybe she's right...$s
records.translation: Sinabi ni Lola na dapat akong maglaan ng mas maraming oras sa pag-aaral.#$e#Baka tama siya...$s

records.source: I finally took the plunge... I've decided to stop putting gel in my hair.#$e#I wouldn't want to be friends with someone who only liked me because I have gel in my hair.
records.translation: Sa wakas ay naglakas-loob ako... Nagpasiya akong ihinto ang paglalagay ng gel sa buhok ko.#$e#Ayaw kong maging kaibigan ng isang taong gusto lang ako dahil may gel ang buhok ko.

records.source: @! Um... Hi.$l
records.translation: @! Um... Kumusta.$l

records.source: Winter is kind of lame. There's too much snow to do anything fun.#$e#I guess some people like it.
records.translation: Medyo pangit ang taglamig. Napakakapal ng niyebe kaya walang magawang masaya.#$e#Siguro ay gusto iyon ng ilang tao.

records.source: You like the snow? Me... I'm just looking forward to spring.
records.translation: Gusto mo ang niyebe? Ako... hinihintay ko lang ang tagsibol.

records.source: Hey, can you go find Haley and tell her I said 'hi'?
records.translation: Hoy, maaari mo bang hanapin si Haley at sabihing kinukumusta ko siya?

records.source: Oh, hey. How's the married life coming along?$9
records.translation: Ah, hoy. Kumusta ang buhay may-asawa?$9

records.source: People stay indoors a lot during the winter, and do boring stuff.$s#$e#Maybe if I read a book I'd be less bored... nah.
records.translation: Madalas manatili sa loob ang mga tao tuwing taglamig at gumawa ng mga nakababagot na bagay.$s#$e#Baka hindi ako gaanong mababagot kung magbabasa ako ng aklat... hindi na.

records.source: When I turn pro, I'll be so rich that I'll get a vacation home in the tropics.#$e#Then I won't have to deal with these boring winters.
records.translation: Kapag propesyonal na ako, magiging napakayaman ko kaya bibili ako ng bahay-bakasyunan sa tropiko.#$e#Pagkatapos ay hindi ko na kailangang tiisin ang nakababagot na mga taglamig na ito.

records.source: You came all the way through the snow to see me?#$e#I guess that makes sense.
records.translation: Dumaan ka pa sa niyebe para makita ako?#$e#Siguro ay makatuwiran iyon.

records.source: There's some weird people living in this town.#$e#...like that guy Sebastian. Why does he wear black all the time?#$e#I don't get it.
records.translation: May ilang kakaibang taong nakatira sa bayang ito.#$e#...tulad ng lalaking iyon na si Sebastian. Bakit lagi siyang nakasuot ng itim?#$e#Hindi ko maunawaan.

records.source: Hey, the gridball game is on today!#$e#This might be my favorite day of the week.
records.translation: Hoy, ipinapalabas ngayon ang laro ng gridball!#$e#Baka ito ang paborito kong araw ng linggo.

records.source: You came all the way through the snow to see me?#$e#That's nice of you.$h
records.translation: Dumaan ka pa sa niyebe para makita ako?#$e#Napakabait mo.$h

records.source: I guess it's interesting that some people are totally different than us, you know?#$b#I don't always understand why others act the way they do, but that's fine.
records.translation: Siguro ay kawili-wili ring may ilang taong lubos na naiiba sa atin, alam mo?#$b#Hindi ko laging nauunawaan kung bakit ganoon kumilos ang iba, pero ayos lang.

records.source: Hey, @. Could you do me a favor?$l#$b#If you see Haley, tell her I'm busy.$l#$e#Thanks.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Maaari mo ba akong tulungan?$l#$b#Kung makita mo si Haley, sabihin mong abala ako.$l#$e#Salamat.

records.source: I'll admit... I was a little jealous when you and Haley got married. But, hey... It's a chance for me to learn something new about myself.$9
records.translation: Aaminin ko... Medyo nainggit ako noong nagpakasal kayo ni Haley. Pero... pagkakataon ito upang may matutuhan akong bago tungkol sa sarili ko.$9

records.source: You know what? I'm going to start reading a book!
records.translation: Alam mo? Magsisimula akong magbasa ng aklat!

records.source: I wish I could control the weather.
records.translation: Sana ay makontrol ko ang panahon.

records.source: If I ever make a lot of money, I'll make sure all my friends and family are taken care of.#$e#That means you, too.$h
records.translation: Kung kumita ako ng napakaraming pera, titiyakin kong maaalagaan ang lahat ng kaibigan at kapamilya ko.#$e#Kasama ka roon.$h
